{"reason": "v1 spent 34x45000 on supplier switches plus 4x150000 stockouts (cost 2165000). Failure rows high/10.0-13.2 and medium/11.5 never stocked out with buffers >=10, so monitor (0) beats 45000; stockout rows medium/5.3 and 2.8 show alternative-supplier lead can exceed stock: alert-planner (35000, always on time) for inventory<6; suggest only mid-buffer medium/high.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((< inventory-days 6)
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= inventory-days 10)
     (list 'monitor))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
